name: Gadi
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy

points: Shallum reigns a full month in Samaria before Menahem son of Gadi goes up from Tirzah, smites him, and reigns in his stead.

note.label: 2 Kings 15: The Kings of a Divided House
